Hi team,

Thanks for a focused weekly sync this morning. I captured the high-level asks and open items below — please confirm owners and ETA by EOD so we can lock the QBR narrative. I attached a small hand-off matrix and the first-pass QBR prompt deck.

Top items (owners in parens):
- Finalize exec ask wording for the model rollout (LAUREN) — need one-line ask + ROI bullets for exec slide.
- Confirm roadmap exception for quantization (KARTHIK) — clarify scope and mitigation plan.
- Throughput and p99 latency snapshot for Dedicated pool (MARCUS) — include last 7d median + peak.
- Procurement timeline + SOC2 evidence request (ACME contact: Brian) — Laura, own procurement coordination.
- Update rollout fallback policy wording for the customer-facing runbook (VIVEK) — I'll draft a short paragraph and share.

Attachments: hand-off-matrix.xlsx; QBR-prompt-deck-v1.pptx

Please reply inline with owner confirmations or flag if this needs escalation.

Thanks,
Vivek

On Jun 14, 2027, at 09:12, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Top items (owners in parens):
> - Confirm roadmap exception for quantization (KARTHIK) — clarify scope and mitigation plan.

Quick update: the quantization work flagged as an exception is limited to two internal models (small LLMs used for reranking). The issue is an unexpected regression in a subset of prompts when using int8 fallback on older kernel versions.

Mitigation plan (short):
- Pause canary for reranker models scheduled 6/18 — we will run expanded prompt regressions and re-evaluate kernel pinning.
- If regressions persist, fallback to fp16 for the canary and schedule a hotfix for kernel 1.4.2.
- I'll update the hand-off-matrix.xlsx with a mitigation row (attaching exec-asks-tracker.csv for context).

ETA: I will upload the updated matrix and tracker by 6/15 3pm PT.

Karthik
Senior Engineering Manager, Inference

Attachment: exec-asks-tracker.csv
